notes:
Autowelcome faster on busy accounts (OnlyFans' 3-second rule still kept):
 - At least 3.2 s between ANY two sends - also after YOUR own messages (PokeFlow notices when you press Enter).
 - No more ~6 s waiting for "Reply sent by" + 1.5 s pause after each welcome: it is checked in the background
   (up to 45 s) while the next sub is already being welcomed. 6 new subs: ~22 s instead of ~60 s.
 - Fix: when a card slides under the panel's top bar, the name could be read from the wrong place ("Eric" on Bob's
   card, or "4" from the bell counter) - the name now comes from FansMetric's own order of the card.
 - RUN_NOTIF_PROBE.bat can now read what is under your MOUSE: for subs whose reply box you can see but PokeFlow
   says "can't quick-reply" (point at the box while it reads).
